ada_hello.speaker: Ada
text: Oh! A visitor. I'm Ada. I've looked after this garden for years.
I dropped my gate key somewhere past the pond, and the slimes moved in after that. The best part of the garden is locked behind that gate.

options.o: Thank you. Mind the slimes. They bounce.
Roses. Hundreds of them. I haven't seen them in weeks.

text.t: Any luck? It's somewhere past the pond, I'm sure of it.
text.else: Still here? The key is somewhere past the pond, if you're curious.

ada_key.speaker: Ada
text: You found it! That's my key.

text.else: I didn't think anyone would bother.

options.o: Ada smiles and walks straight to the gate. You hear the lock turn.
Ada looks at the key, then at you, and says nothing.

ada_thanks.speaker: Ada
text: Go on in. I'll be right behind you.

ada_quiet.speaker: Ada
text: Ada is busy with the weeds, and doesn't look up.
